statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, ∀ x y : ℝ, |x-y| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)^2/(n:ℝ) → (1:ℝ)/2 < K n x → (1:ℝ)/3 < K n y

plain_statement.zh: 共振峰在有理中心邻域保持可检测
plain_statement.en: Detect resonances from a nearby rational center

brief.zh: 对余弦和取 Lipschitz 上界；最大频率 2ᴸ 约为 √n。尺度 Q²/n 上的变化最终小于 1/6。该结论允许在有限分母的中心处做离散分析。
brief.en: Bound the cosine derivative by its frequency. The top frequency is of order √n, so the variation at scale Q²/n eventually falls below 1/6; this makes rational-center analysis possible.
